The Complete Mailing Address column on Schedule A (p3) is covered by a SOLID BLACK COUNTY REDACTION bar running the full height of the table, so donor_city/donor_state are blank because they were REDACTED - distinct from the several filings in this chunk where the filer simply left the address empty.
